The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Sri Ganganagar, Rohtak, Shahjahanpur, Sultanpur, Gaya, Bankura and thence eastwards towards Mizoram.
The Western Disturbance as cyclonic circulation over Kashmir & neighbourhood has become less marked, however the trough aloft in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 71°E to the north of Lat. 31°N.
The cyclonic circulation over West Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood and lies over northwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North Haryana & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level merged with above system
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Tamil Nadu- Puducherry between 5.8 & 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central parts of south Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood now lies over southwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood between 4.5 & 7.6 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Bihar now lies over northeast Bihar & adjoining Sub- Himalayan West Bengal & Sikkim between 3.1 & 7.6 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central Assam persists and now seen between 1.5 & 5.8 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Southeast Bay of Bengal between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Northeast Bangladesh & neighbourhood persists and now seen at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over South Interior Karnataka & neighbourhoodat 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
